description: Capability for the WebUI window served by the backend: remote content may reach ONLY the host login bridge, the device capabilities the WebUI presents as its own (show a path in the file manager, raise a system notification, hand a link to the browser, navigate this window to another page of this same app), and error forwarding. No backend-lifecycle command is granted here — the remote page must not be able to stop, start or reconfigure the backend.
